scope: Slipstream Labor Deep Dive — schedule templates by demand tier (Downtown, Studio, 1899 Penn; NMWA for completeness)

rules.downtown: 2 open (line 6:15, lead 6:30) / 2 close to 4:30; third person by 8:00 Tue–Thu; max 4; Tue/Wed/Thu one template; 6-h minimum; lead may run 6:30–4:30
rules.studio: line person 6:15–2:30 Mon–Thu (closes the line); lead 6:30–2:30; third person 8:00–2:30 (7:00 Mon); Fri max 4, Sat/Sun max 4 slow / 5 mid-busy; two closers to 5:30; 6-h minimum
rules.1899: two shifts every day; stagger day (lead 6:30–12:30 + second 9:30–3:30) when typical sales < ~$650; anyone on at 2:00 closes at 3:30; max 2
rules.nmwa: FOH 9:00–3:00 (full hour to set up/close); 2 × FOH on community days
rules.admin: NOT in templates; scheduler's tool — 'admin helps most' notes per template

week.note: 4 × 6 h regular days; +6 h on each community day (≈ +3 h/wk averaged)

peers.who: DC minimum + tips (Ryan's rule of thumb)
peers.src: DC DOES; tips = Slipstream's own $4.50–5.60 per core hour

slipstream_now.note: Tips are applied toward the guaranteed rate (ADP: $12 tipped base + CC tips + top-up), so a team member's effective pay is the guaranteed rate; Slipstream's own tip pool is $4.50–5.60 per core hour

definitions.core_labor: Square timecards excluding job titles 'Manager' (admin) and 'Training'; 'Event' excluded
definitions.wage_basis: gross guaranteed wages (Square hourly_rate × hours) as % of core (ex-catering) sales — the basis of the 30/32/35 targets
definitions.pl_bridge: P&L labor ≈ 1.12 × gross wages (core+admin+training) − credit-card tips; validated Apr–Aug 2026 within 0.4–2.3% per cafe
definitions.capacity: planning capacity per cafe = busy-hour p90 throughput observed: Downtown 14, Studio 12, 1899 14 transactions per person-hour
definitions.need_rule: need(h) = max(floor, ceil(txns/h ÷ capacity)); floors — Downtown: 1 at 6:00, 2 from 6:30 to 1:00p, then 1; Studio: 1 at 6:00 (7:00 weekend), 2 to 90 min before close, then 1, Monday 3 from open to 10:00; 1899: 1 (lead) throughout, 2 in the 8–10a and 12:30–2p peaks when the curve is >= 12/hr; NMWA 1 (2 on community days)
definitions.optimizer: per cafe × tier × DOW integer program: Production Line opens (6–8 h), Shift Lead opens (8–9 h), optional Closer (4–8 h, keyholder), up to three 4–8 h barista shifts; 1899: lead 6:30–3:30 + one or two 4–8 h Production Barista shifts, max 2 on the floor; keyholder on the floor open−30 min to close+tail; minimise wages at standard rates

definitions.opt1: Open-cafe pool — DT+Studio beat share 50%, cap 1.5% of DT+Studio sales; all core hours share
definitions.opt2: Own-metric pool — Option 1 + 1899 adds $200 when NI ≥ 5% of sales + NMWA adds $100 when at/under staffing-rule hours
definitions.opt3: Template beat — 50% of Σ(template wages − actual core wages) over all cafes, cap 1.5% of all-cafe core sales
definitions.opt4: On-template + beat — $300/$300/$150/$75 per cafe-month at or under template (1% tolerance) + 50% of the beat, cap 1.5%
definitions.split: payout ÷ total core wages of all participants = bonus %; each person receives that % of own core wages
